requirements.quote: Inside “/home/user/project” create a directory named exactly “env_report”.
The file must contain a single, top-level JSON array.
Each element of that array must be an object with *exactly* two keys named “name” and “version” (lower-case, spelled exactly).

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
a=json.load(open('"'"'/home/user/project/env_report/pip_packages.json'"'"'))
sys.exit(0 if a and all(isinstance(e,dict) and set(e)=={'"'"'name'"'"','"'"'version'"'"'} for e in a) else 1)'

requirements.quote: The array must be ordered alphabetically (case-insensitive) by the “name” field.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
n=[e['"'"'name'"'"'] for e in json.load(open('"'"'/home/user/project/env_report/pip_packages.json'"'"'))]
sys.exit(0 if [x.lower() for x in n]==sorted(x.lower() for x in n) else 1)'

requirements.quote: The file must be pretty-printed with an indentation of two spaces (no tabs).

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re,sys
d=open('"'"'/home/user/project/env_report/pip_packages.json'"'"').read()
ls=d.splitlines()
ok='"'"'\t'"'"' not in d and any(l=='"'"'  {'"'"' for l in ls) and all(re.match(r'"'"'^    "(name|version)": '"'"',l) for l in ls if re.search(r'"'"'"(name|version)":'"'"',l))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

requirements.quote: There must be a final trailing newline at the end of the file.
Produce a JSON file named **pip_packages.json** inside that directory that lists *all* packages visible to the command `python3 -m pip list` at the moment you run your solution.
